dialogues.speaker: Crumpled Bill
dialogues.text: (A crumpled bill, with a few lines scribbled on the back.)

dialogues.speaker: Crumpled Bill
dialogues.text: "...the bag guy brought the news: the people of Liyue want to eat alone, and His Honor is not pleased... Someone has to make them wear stiff shoes..."

dialogues.speaker: Crumpled Bill
dialogues.text: "...the boss intends to set out at sundown, summon that good guy Walker, and bring even more soldiers..."
